meta.title: Neutral Ground: Third Floor Kitchen
meta.tagline: Halberd & Pike Mutual is being eaten alive by Greyline Assurance. The kitchen is the last place nobody owns. You own the yoghurt map.
meta.era: a fluorescent present, Monday to Friday
meta.premise: Halberd & Pike Mutual, a mid-sized insurer with a beige carpet and a 1987 mission statement, is being absorbed by Greyline Assurance. Every meeting room has been annexed, every desk re-tagged. Only the third-floor kitchen is neutral ground, by an old fire-safety clause nobody dares test. Pip Okonedo-Marsh, agency temp, has spent six weeks learning whose labelled yoghurt is whose. That is the most valuable intelligence in the building. On Friday at four, the all-hands decides which departments survive the integration. Pip intends to have a say.
meta.prompt: A mid-sized insurance firm is being swallowed by its rival, and the only neutral ground left is the third-floor kitchen. You're the temp who knows whose labelled yoghurt is whose — trade gossip, forge meeting invites, and decide which department survives Friday's all-hands.

str.name: Elbows
str.description: Getting through a crowded corridor and to the front of the microwave queue.

dex.name: Discretion
dex.description: Being somewhere without being noticed there. Dodging eye contact and actions.

int.name: Gossip
int.description: Knowing who, what and whose. Powers every clever remark.

hp.name: Composure
hp.description: How long you can keep smiling. At zero you hand in your lanyard and go home.

mp.name: Goodwill
mp.description: Favours people still feel they owe you. Spent on social manoeuvres.

ac.name: Deniability
ac.description: How well blame slides off you.

statuses.name: Double-booked
statuses.description: Two meetings at once. You stand frozen in the corridor working out which to skip.

statuses.name: Decaf
statuses.description: Out of caffeine. Your eyes close a little and your comebacks come late.

statuses.name: Queasy
statuses.description: That yoghurt was not yours and it was not fresh.

statuses.name: Jittery
statuses.description: Triple espresso. Everything is fast and slightly too loud.

statuses.name: Out of Office
statuses.description: An auto-reply walks in front of you. Nobody sees you unless you bump into them.

statuses.name: Cultured
statuses.description: Live probiotic cultures. Your composure knits itself back together.

statuses.name: CC'd on Everything
statuses.description: Forty unread threads in your head. Hard to dodge anything.

statuses.name: Flustered
statuses.description: Caught out in public. You want to leave the conversation now.

resources.name: Caffeine
resources.description: What keeps the temp upright. Drains slowly; coffee refills it. Empty means Decaf.

rules.name: Neutral Ground
rules.description: Kitchen lino is neutral by fire-safety clause: every turn you end standing on a lino tile you regain 1 Composure.

rules.name: Caffeine Economy
rules.description: You lose 1 Caffeine every 25 turns. At zero you become Decaf (-2 Discretion, -2 Gossip) until you drink something. Coffee machines and coffee refill it.

effects.text: Your eyelids file a formal complaint. You are running on decaf.

player.name: Pip Okonedo-Marsh
player.title: Agency Temp, Week Six
player.description: Lanyard says VISITOR. Mustard cardigan, a phone full of screenshots, and a mental map of every labelled tub in the third-floor fridge.

perks.name: Thick Skin
perks.description: You have survived three reorganisations and a Secret Santa. +4 Composure.

perks.name: Ear to the Wall
perks.description: Every thin partition is a podcast. +2 Gossip.

perks.name: Hot-desker
perks.description: No fixed address, no fixed target. +1 Discretion, +1 Deniability.

perks.name: Weaponised Small Talk
perks.description: Learn Small Talk: a remark about the weekend that leaves someone reeling.

perks.name: Let's Circle Back
perks.description: Learn Circle Back: push everyone near you away and make them nervous.

perks.name: Biscuit Diplomacy
perks.description: Every rival you sideline leaves 2 biscuits on the desk, out of respect.

perks.name: Stairwell Breather
perks.description: When Composure dips low, you take ninety seconds in the stairwell and recover 8 Composure (sometimes).

perks.name: Iron Stomach
perks.description: +2 Elbows and +3 Composure. Nothing in that fridge can hurt you now.

perks.name: Corner-Office Voice
perks.description: You have learned to speak like a director. +2 Gossip, +1 Deniability.

actors.name: Greyline Consultant
actors.description: Grey fleece gilet, grey laptop, grey smile. Here to 'understand your workflows' and then delete them.

attack.name: Synergy Question
attack.verb: asks what exactly you do at

actors.name: Passive-Aggressive Post-it
actors.description: A flock of yellow notes: 'SOME of us wash our mugs :)'. They flutter in packs and sting with punctuation.

actors.name: Reply-All Chain
actors.description: A thread that will not die, sliding along the skirting board, every link another 'Please remove me from this list'.

actors.name: Microwave Queue Warden
actors.description: Has stood guard by the microwave since the fish incident of 2019. Will not let you reheat anything without a hearing.

actors.name: Circular Reference
actors.description: A red loop of logic that refers to itself until it refers to you. Rolls through the cells blinking a warning triangle.

actors.name: Merged Cell
actors.description: Twelve departments merged into one block of grey and it has not stopped growing. Slow, heavy and impossible to sort.

actors.name: #REF! Error
actors.description: A hovering broken link that drifts towards you at odd angles. It points at things that no longer exist and makes you doubt you do.

actors.name: Pivot Table
actors.description: An elite summary of everyone's worth, turning on its axis to show your department in the worst light.

abilities.name: Show in a Bad Light
abilities.description: Turns the numbers so you look careless.

actors.name: Rumour Mill
actors.description: A grape-cluster of whispering mouths on a creeping vine. It spits half-truths across the room and shuffles after anyone who argues.

actors.name: Watercooler Whisper
actors.description: A cold draught that sounds like your name. Waits in the bends of the vine and leans in close.

actors.name: Integration HR Liaison
actors.description: Lanyard with three badges, both logos. Speaks entirely in calendar invites and never accepts a decline.

abilities.name: Calendar Ambush
abilities.description: Sends an invite that overlaps everything you had planned.

actors.name: Odile Greaves, Chief Integration Officer
actors.description: Cream power suit, red pen, no surname on her yoghurt, only initials: O.G. She has already written Friday's slide deck. Your department is on slide 41.

abilities.name: Synergy Deck
abilities.description: Clicks through forty slides at you in under a minute.

abilities.name: Restructure
abilities.description: Calls two consultants in from the corridor to 'support the transition'.

npc.personality: Polished, patient, faintly amused. Genuinely believes consolidation is kindness. Was a Halberd & Pike temp herself in 1998 and has never mentioned it.
npc.greeting: Ah. The temp. Lovely cardigan. Do sit down, this will only take forty-one slides.
lines: Nobody is losing their job. Some people are gaining an opportunity elsewhere.
I've seen your timesheets. You're in that kitchen a great deal.
npc.secrets: She started as a Halberd temp in 1998 and still keeps her yoghurt in the third-floor fridge, labelled O.G. Greyline's board plans to sell both firms' claims departments to a shell company on Monday; she has not decided whether to stop it.
npc.wants: A clean merger with no surprises at the all-hands. Secretly, for someone from the old firm to prove it was worth saving.

actors.name: Maureen from Facilities
actors.description: Keeper of the fridge, the dishwasher rota and the only working key to the stationery cupboard. Has outlasted four CEOs.

npc.personality: Brisk, unflappable, trades exclusively in biscuits. Loves a bit of gossip but will never admit it. Calls everybody 'petal'.
npc.greeting: Mind the floor, petal, I've just mopped. You after something from the cupboard?
lines: Friday is cleaning-out-the-fridge day. Anything unlabelled goes in the bin. Anything labelled, I read.
The Greyline lot put their milk on the top shelf. Bold.
Biscuits up front. I don't do invoices.
npc.secrets: The yoghurt labelled O.G. belongs to the Chief Integration Officer, who sneaks up here at 7am. The fire door key fob is in the microwave queue warden's coat pocket, or near enough.
npc.wants: For somebody, anybody, to finally wash the communal mugs. And to keep her job past Friday.

actors.name: Dev from IT
actors.description: Lives inside the integration spreadsheet now. Has not seen daylight since the merger announcement. Wears his headphones as armour.

npc.personality: Fast-talking, sleep-deprived, conspiratorial. Explains everything with too many acronyms, then apologises.
npc.greeting: Oh thank god, a face. Nobody's opened tab four in weeks. Mind the circular references, they bite.
lines: Every department is a row. Every row has a delete button. I've seen who has edit access.
The Pivot Table's hiding a column called PROJECT YOGHURT. I can't unhide it. Maybe you can.
If you see a #REF!, don't look at it directly.
npc.secrets: There is a hidden column in the integration sheet: both claims departments are scheduled to be sold to a shell company. The rumour about it has leaked into the grapevine beneath the building.
npc.wants: Coffee. Real coffee. And for someone to back up the spreadsheet before Greyline deletes the old tabs.

actors.name: Carol from Payroll
actors.description: Has a desk drawer of emergency supplies and a memory for every pay rise since 1994. Somehow down here, in the grapevine, knitting.

npc.personality: Warm, unhurried, devastatingly well informed. Feeds people. Never repeats a rumour unless it is true.
npc.greeting: Sit down, love, you look grey. Have a biscuit. Now, what have you heard?
lines: Everyone ends up down here eventually. The grapevine runs under every floor.
I've done the leaving collections for eleven people this month. I'm not doing yours.
Odile? She was a temp, once. Sat at your desk.
npc.secrets: Odile Greaves was a Halberd & Pike temp in 1998 and Carol trained her. Carol knows the shell company's name from a payroll test run.
npc.wants: For the claims team to survive, mostly because they always remember her birthday.

items.name: Laminated Lanyard
items.description: A VISITOR lanyard swung with intent. It snaps against people's sense of security.

items.name: Heavy Stapler
items.description: Cast iron, 1970s, property of Claims. Slammed on a desk it ends discussions.

items.name: Presentation Clicker
items.description: The red dot wanders to whoever is talking nonsense and stays there until they stop.
items.vagueText: Works from across the room. Not as forceful as being there in person.

items.name: Cardigan of Plausible Deniability
items.description: Mustard, bobbly, enormous pockets. Nothing that happens near it is ever quite its wearer's fault.

items.name: Fire Warden Hi-Vis
items.description: Nobody argues with a fire warden. Nobody even checks whether you are one.

items.name: Employee of the Month Pin
items.description: March 2011. Not yours. People still straighten up when they see it.
items.vagueText: Faintly official. People seem to listen to whoever wears it.

items.name: Builder's Tea
items.description: Strong enough to stand a spoon in. Two sugars. The universal truce of the third floor.

items.name: Tin Shortbread
items.description: From the tartan tin nobody admits to bringing in. Buttery, calming, slightly stale.

items.name: Filter Coffee
items.description: From the pot that has been on the hotplate since nine. Bitter, but it works.

items.name: Triple Espresso
items.description: From the Greyline machine with the touchscreen. Nobody knows what it does to a person.
items.vagueText: Almost black, almost solid. You will be very awake and very fast for a while.

items.name: Labelled Yoghurt
items.description: Thick Greek yoghurt. Somebody's whole lunch. Deeply restorative and deeply stolen.

items.name: Expired Yoghurt
items.description: Best before the previous CEO. Fizzes slightly when opened. Do not.

items.name: Probiotic Shot
items.description: Live cultures from the wellness drawer. Your composure starts quietly repairing itself.

items.name: Forged Calendar Invite
items.description: An urgent 'quick sync' in a room that does not exist. The recipient freezes trying to find it.

items.name: Out-of-Office Reply
items.description: 'I am currently away from my desk.' Pinned to your chest, it makes it true for everyone looking.

items.name: Label Maker
items.description: Prints tiny certain truths onto tape. Point it at a mystery and it tells you what it is.

items.name: Small Talk
items.description: 'Doing anything nice this weekend?' asked with such precision that the target needs a moment.

items.name: Circle Back
items.description: 'Let's circle back on that.' Everyone near you steps away, unsure what they agreed to.

items.name: Rumour: The Parking Levy
items.description: Greyline plans to charge Halberd staff for the car park. Carrying it makes you quicker with a reply.

items.name: Rumour: Project Yoghurt
items.description: A hidden spreadsheet column: both claims departments sold to a shell firm on Monday. The real merger.

items.name: Rumour: Who O.G. Was
items.description: The Chief Integration Officer started here as a temp in 1998. At your desk. With your stapler.

items.name: Fire Door Key Fob
items.description: Opens the third-floor fire door. Beyond it, apparently, is the integration spreadsheet. Facilities have stopped asking.

items.name: Blank All-Hands Invite
items.description: Friday 4pm, the agenda still blank. Hold all three rumours, then use it in the boardroom to write the agenda yourself.

effects.text: Agenda item one: Project Yoghurt. Sent to all staff, both firms, reply-all enabled.

terrains.name: Kitchen Lino
terrains.description: Cream and teal squares. Neutral ground by fire-safety clause; stand here and breathe.

terrains.name: Coffee Machine
terrains.description: A bean-to-cup machine humming on a cart. Search it for a cup.

effects.text: The machine grinds, wheezes and gives you something brown. It will do.

terrains.name: Spilled Coffee
terrains.description: A sticky brown puddle. Somebody will be emailing about this.

terrains.name: Grapevine Curtain
terrains.description: Hanging tendrils that murmur names. You can push through them, but you cannot see past.

yoghurt.label: Unlabelled yoghurt with a frowny face

areas.name: The Kitchen Commons
areas.description: The last neutral room in the building, and the corridors either side of it. Cream lino, a humming fridge, two microwaves, and Greyline consultants circling the kettle.
areas.gmNotes: Comedy of territory: Greyline consultants patrol, Halberd staff guard the microwave. Maureen trades for biscuits. The fob is guarded near the exit. Yoghurt labels are clues to who eats where. Keep it petty and specific.

areas.name: The Integration Spreadsheet (Tab Four)
areas.description: Beyond the fire door there is no stairwell, just an endless pale grid of cells hanging in white space. Departments are rows. Some are being deleted as you watch.
areas.gmNotes: Non-realistic: the inside of the shared integration sheet. No ceiling, no gravity worth mentioning. Dev from IT knows about the hidden PROJECT YOGHURT column, which the Pivot Table guards. Kitchen lino patches here are where someone pasted the kitchen in by mistake.

areas.name: The Grapevine
areas.description: Under every floor runs the grapevine: warm purple tunnels of murmuring tendrils where every rumour in the building ends up, still whispering. It smells of instant soup.
areas.transitionName: Climb the dumbwaiter to the boardroom
areas.gmNotes: Organic and intimate. Rumours are alive here. Carol from Payroll heals and knows Odile was a temp. The HR Liaison guards the dumbwaiter up to Friday's boardroom. Let whispers say the player's name.

areas.name: Boardroom 9, Friday 4pm
areas.description: The all-hands. Navy carpet, a table the length of a bus, both logos on the screen, and two hundred chairs facing the woman with the red pen.
areas.gmNotes: Finale. Odile can be out-argued (Rebut) or bypassed: with all three rumours, using the Blank All-Hands Invite here forges the agenda and wins. If the player talks to her, she is tired and curious, not cruel.

goal.summary: Decide Friday's all-hands: out-argue Chief Integration Officer Odile Greaves, or carry all three rumours to the boardroom and use the blank invite to rewrite the agenda.
goal.winText: The slide deck stalls on slide 41. Somebody asks about Project Yoghurt and the room goes quiet, then loud. By Monday the shell company is cancelled, Claims survives, and your contract has been extended indefinitely. Maureen leaves a tin of shortbread on your desk. There is no label. There doesn't need to be.
goal.lossText: You hand back the VISITOR lanyard at reception. On Friday the all-hands runs exactly to schedule, all forty-one slides of it. On Monday, someone else's temp opens the fridge and finds your yoghurt, still labelled.

gm.persona: The third-floor fridge: humming, cold, privy to every label and every lunch for twenty years, and very, very petty on behalf of its regulars.
gm.voice: Dry and confiding, like a building announcement written by someone who has seen too much. Short sentences. The occasional compressor hum.
threads: Whose yoghurt is labelled O.G., and why is it always here at 7am?
Project Yoghurt: the hidden column in the integration sheet.
Maureen's mug crusade and the dishwasher rota.
Every department as a row that can be deleted.
Friday 4pm draws closer with each floor.

fallback.intro: Monday, 8:58. Halberd & Pike Mutual has four days left to exist. Greyline Assurance has taken the meeting rooms, the car park and the good chairs. Only the third-floor kitchen is neutral ground, and I am its fridge. I have watched you for six weeks, temp. You know whose yoghurt is whose. That makes you the most dangerous person in the building. Friday's all-hands decides who survives. Go and decide it.
areaEnter: The kitchen commons. Lino squares, a dripping tap, a kettle with an audience. Stand on the lino and nobody can touch you, officially.
The fire door opens onto white. Not a stairwell: a spreadsheet, rows to the horizon. Somewhere a cell is being deleted, and it has your name in it.
Down the grapevine now. Warm, purple, murmuring. Every rumour in the building ends up here, and some of them are about you.
Boardroom 9. Friday, 4pm. Two hundred chairs. One red pen. The slide deck is already loaded.
lowHp: Your smile is going stiff at the corners. Find some lino. Find some tea.
Composure fraying. Somebody, somewhere, is drafting your leaving card.
events: A microwave pings three times. Nobody claims it.
An email lands: 'Reminder: please label ALL items in the fridge.'
Somewhere, a fluorescent tube gives up.
The fridge hums a little louder. That means it is on your side.

audio.mood: Bright, slightly wonky office muzak over a hum of fluorescent tubes and a nervous ticking clock.
